Plugins, mods and the rest of a Claude Code 2.1.296 setup travel with it, every choice has a flag, and the fixes of reviews 15 and 16.

**Plugins and mods (T95 to T106)**

- Marketplace plugins are saved with their versions in `.agentnomad/plugin-versions.json`; pull names each plugin Claude Code installed in another version
- Local-folder marketplaces travel with their files and are restored on pull, re-cloned when the commit is on the remote
- Plugin folders named in `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS` are saved and written back on pull, the value pointed at the folders pull wrote
- Plugins and mods kept in `skills/` are saved; generated types are never pushed, pull reviews them with `claude plugin validate`, and `--yes` never accepts code
- claude.ai skills and uploaded plugins are backed up and restored (as local plugins) unless you say no (`--no-account-skills`, `--no-account-plugins`); `--yes` includes them
- Plugin data and store files are opt-in (`--plugin-data`) and put back after the plugin is installed; `node_modules` and runnable files are refused
- Pull warns about mods on a Claude Code older than 2.1.287; push names mods in `dev-mods/` and never takes them

**More of the setup (T107 to T115)**

- Claude Code 2.1.296: push knows every state file of the config folder (27 never synced, 11 known state) and the unknown-files warning stays quiet for all of them
- `~/.claude.json` is complete: a project's local MCP servers, `.mcp.json` choices and all documented preference keys are saved and merged back
- A global push with `--memory` saves the auto memory of every project; pull puts it back, the project's copy winning
- `CLAUDE.md` `@path` imports travel with the setup (Markdown and plain text, four hops); push names each imported file it cannot take
- `hooks/` folders are synced whole; push names every hook or status-line script it cannot take
- `loop.md` is synced like `CLAUDE.md`; shares, scratch, agent memory and local settings stay never synced
- Every push and pull choice has a flag (`--env-values` on both, `--skip-existing` on pull); `--help` says what each command saves, restores or never touches; push and pull show their plan and ask once

**Safety and fixes from reviews 15 and 16 (T116 to T128)**

- Pull gates: one case-blind rule for plugin file names, `skills/` folders and the base folder on every platform; every `GIT_*` and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` variable is gated; quoted frontmatter hooks are shown; risky mod hooks (`tool.check`, `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`) are flagged; unsafe `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS` entries are dropped
- Push checks the bundle file cap before encoding and says which setup is over it
- Server: a download race fixed; orphaned blobs swept in the background, oldest first, with an index on `bundle_blobs.created_at`
- Tests prove what their titles say, one set of shared helpers; threat model, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and CONTRIBUTING match the code

Older CLIs (1.0.3 to 1.0.6) keep working against the server; the bundle format is unchanged.

Install or update: `npm install -g agentnomad@latest` (Node.js 22.13 or newer).
